method_descriptions.claims_point: Submitted-claims point estimate, no maturity/access/cost guardrail.
method_descriptions.gross_point: Gross-loss point estimate, no maturity/access/cost guardrail.
method_descriptions.strong_conventional: Access/cost-aware bounded comparison assuming present outcomes complete.
method_descriptions.integrated: Maturity-aware, label-uncertainty-aware comparison with access/cost safeguards.

limitations: The two point baselines ignore access/cost and prioritize retire.
Strong conventional is a stronger comparator but assumes presently observed loss is complete.
These fictional settings do not demonstrate superior results in every real setting.
